name: WI-04
label: Safe D

key_factors: Long-serving incumbent Gwen Moore running for reelection
Challenger Tim Rogers has no reported fundraising
Prediction markets price Moore near certain to win
model.rationale: Milwaukee-based WI-04 is a heavily Democratic seat with a well-funded incumbent and a challenger showing no financial footprint, and markets price Moore at about 97% to win. Nothing in the evidence suggests movement away from the fundamentals.
model.watch: A surprise scandal or major outside spending against Moore would be the main way this race tightens.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview: Gwen Moore has represented this Milwaukee-area district since 2005, and the seat is one of the most Democratic in Wisconsin, with a partisan lean of D+26. She is running for reelection and has raised over a million dollars, while Republican Tim Rogers reports no fundraising and no outside groups are active in the race. No public polls cover the contest, and no expert raters have flagged it as competitive. Prediction markets put Moore's chances at roughly 97 percent. The combination of a deep-blue electorate, incumbency, and a financially inactive challenger makes this a Safe Democratic race with little realistic path for an upset.
